description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jiang Yanggu, adding {C}{C}.
When Jiang Yanggu dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Jiang Yanggu from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Jiang Yanggu enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
